slices.behaviour: A route is read only for the plan it routed: the route record names the accepted solution advance, and for_slice, the handoff pack and the implementer's copies all fall back when the plan has been replaced and nobody has routed it again.
slices.failure_reason: AssertionError: {'position': 1, 'name': 'The status line', ... 'model': 'sonnet', 'effort': 'medium', 'source': 'jev', ...} is not None, and 'No route' not found in the pack, which instead read 'Runs on: sonnet at medium effort, by Jev at 0.7.' for a slice that had become 'Fee expectations' over packages/core/src/fees.ts, which a rule routes to the strongest model at high effort.
